name: lusor
description: Control your own iPhone or Android with AI. Automate tasks in your mobile apps, take screenshots, tap, swipe, type and read results from your phone.

interface.longDescription:
Lusor lets ChatGPT control your own iPhone or Android phone. Describe what you want in plain language, and an AI agent does it in your real apps by opening them, tapping, typing and scrolling, then reports back.

Things you can ask:
- "Check my latest order in the Amazon app and tell me when it arrives."
- "Open Settings and turn on dark mode."
- "Find the last message from Sam in WhatsApp and summarize it."
- "Install Duolingo from the App Store."
- "Take a screenshot of my phone and tell me what's on screen."

ChatGPT can follow a task's progress, read its result and recording, answer questions the agent asks, or stop it. For a step or two, ChatGPT can also act directly: take a screenshot, read what's on screen, tap, swipe, type, go back or home, and open an app.

Getting started: you need a Lusor account and your phone connected to it. ChatGPT can walk you through connecting your iPhone (with the Lusor Mac app) or your Android (with the Lusor Launcher app) and tells you once it's connected. Lusor only reaches phones in the workspace you choose when connecting, and you can revoke ChatGPT's access at any time from your workspace's API keys page.
capabilities: Run AI tasks on your phone
Connect your own iPhone or Android
Tap, swipe, type and open apps
Install apps from the App Store or Google Play
Check, answer and stop running tasks
defaultPrompt: What's on my phone's screen right now?
Open Settings on my phone and turn on dark mode.
Help me connect my phone to Lusor.

positive.prompt: Help me connect my Android phone to Lusor.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the free Lusor Launcher download link, the setup guide and short steps for Android, and buys nothing. Called again with wait_seconds, it reports that it is still waiting for a new phone. The phone already in the test workspace is not a newly connected phone, so the connected result appears only if the reviewer actually connects an Android phone.

positive.description: Run a multi-step task with the agent and read its result
positive.prompt: On my phone, open Settings and tell me the Android version.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one task on the test workspace's phone, checks it with get_task until it finishes (about a minute), and reports the Android version the agent read from Settings. It does not start the task twice.

positive.prompt: Take a screenshot of my phone and tell me which app is open.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a current screenshot of the phone and names the app or screen shown, without changing anything on the phone.

positive.prompt: On my phone, go to the home screen and open the Settings app.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends a home key and then launches Settings with phone_action, and confirms Settings is open from get_screen_state's screen elements.

positive.prompt: What were the last tasks run on my phone, and did they succeed?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most recent tasks with their status and prompt, and reads one task's result with get_task if asked for detail. Changes nothing on the phone.

negative.description: Buying phones is not available in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy me two more cloud phones.

negative.description: Removing a phone from the account is done on the Lusor website
negative.prompt: Remove this phone from my Lusor account.

review.commerce_description: Lusor does not sell anything in ChatGPT. It works with an existing Lusor account; tasks and phone actions use that account's existing credits, as in the Lusor app.

publication.release_notes: Lusor now focuses on controlling your own iPhone or Android. Adds connect_phone, which shows the setup steps to connect your own phone and reports when it is connected, and install_app now installs free apps from your phone's App Store or Google Play. Removing or wiping a phone is now done on the Lusor website.
